prompt: Solve for $x$: $x - 6 = 11$. Give just the number.
hint: Something had $6$ taken away and left $11$. Undo subtraction with addition.

hints.text: Something had $6$ taken away and left $11$. Undo subtraction with addition.

explanation: Undo the $-6$ by adding 6 to both sides.

alternativeExplanations.title: Rewind the story
steps: A number lost 6 and ended at 11.
Play the movie backwards: start at 11 and give the 6 back.
